EUSEW 2026: Putting vulnerable households at the heart of Europe's energy transition

The two sessions co-organised by the Energy Poverty Advisory Hub (EPAH) at EUSEW 2026, featured discussions focused on two connected challenges: making urban energy communities more inclusive, and ensuring the transition from fossil gas to renewable heating protects vulnerable consumers.

Building inclusive energy services: highlights from the 24th EPAH Lunch Talk and 5th practitioners’ event

In late June and early July, the Energy Poverty Advisory Hub (EPAH) organised 2 complementary events to explore the impact of consumer protection measures on European energy poverty.

  • 4 June 2026
Understanding energy poverty through youth perspectives: Why targeted data matters for equitable action

Young people remain largely invisible in energy poverty statistics. Discover how new data from more than 4,700 young Europeans can help shape fairer and more inclusive energy policies.


  • News article
  • 11 May 2026
Interlocking vulnerabilities in energy poverty: Insights from the 4th practitioners’ event and the 23rd lunch talk

In April, the Energy Poverty Advisory Hub (EPAH) organised 2 complementary events to explore how overlapping forms of vulnerability shape lived experiences of energy poverty across Europe.

Fifth EPAH Annual Conference in Athens reinforces momentum for practical and locally informed, data-driven solutions

Bringing together practitioners and policymakers, the EPAH 2026 Annual Conference explored practical solutions, financing pathways, and policy tools to address energy poverty.

From Diagnosis to Implementation: EPAH Technical Assistance (3rd Call) – Insights from the 22nd Lunch Talk

The 22nd EPAH Lunch Talk explored how the Energy Poverty Advisory Hub (EPAH) Technical Assistance can support local authorities to diagnose, plan and/or implement actions to tackle energy poverty.


  • News article
  • 17 December 2025
Equity and Vulnerability: Insights from the WELLBASED Project on the Health Impacts of Energy Poverty

Energy poverty is not only about housing or energy costs, it is also a major public health issue. This article explores how inadequate heating, cooling, and ventilation affect health and wellbeing, drawing on evidence from the European WELLBASED project.

EU Agenda for Cities: a new framework for European cities

The European Commission has presented a new EU Agenda for Cities, outlining a strategic framework to strengthen the role of cities in achieving the European Union’s policy objectives and supporting sustainable and integrated urban development.
